action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const evt = new PointerEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.4, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(evt);

const slider = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); if(slider){slider.value='1.5'; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}

const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const evt = new PointerEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.6, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(evt); setTimeout(()=>{const rotKnob = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(el=>el.id!=='scaleSlider')||document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')[1]; if(rotKnob){rotKnob.value='90'; rotKnob.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}}, 500);

postconditions: Bottle Y-rotation changed to ~90 degrees (π/2 radians)

const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const startEvt = new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.6, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(startEvt); setTimeout(()=>{const moveEvt = new PointerEvent('pointermove', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.5, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.6, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(moveEvt);}, 200); setTimeout(()=>{const endEvt = new PointerEvent('pointerup', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.5, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.6, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(endEvt);}, 400); setTimeout(()=>{const clickHelmet = new PointerEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.4, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(clickHelmet);}, 800); setTimeout(()=>{const dragStart = new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.4, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(dragStart);}, 1000); setTimeout(()=>{const dragMove = new PointerEvent('pointermove', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.45, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.4, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(dragMove);}, 1200); setTimeout(()=>{const dragEnd = new PointerEvent('pointerup', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.45, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.4, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(dragEnd);}, 1400);

postconditions: All state fields remain stable for 60 seconds
